result.notes:
Research stage by the plan item's rag. exec/v1 execution-input gets the optional closed field research {need, notes?} (schema, valid/invalid fixtures, docs row). bridges/planner-orch brief.py carries item.rag.need/notes into research (no rag, no field). Conductor engine: _research_wanted follows orch.research.policy (default conditional: only research.need == required; required: every piece; off: never); the result of research.1 reaches every executor round as a new prompt block kind research (## Research: claims with sources, contradictions, unknowns; origin research-result:<file>; budget class retrieval), listed in the manifest. Tests: schema fixtures, brief mapping, prompt block + golden executor-research.md, e2e for need none/optional/required, default policy, off, required-with-none, no sources. Docs and CHANGELOG updated. Tests run: orch test_conductor_research, test_conductor_prompts, test_contracts_input, test_contracts_identity, test_conductor_input, test_conductor_contracts, test_adhoc (130 OK); bridges/planner-orch test_brief (56 OK), test_worksource (41 OK), test_conformance (6 OK), each with a temporary HOME/SKM_HOME. The acceptance check V1 (affected-tests --run), schema compat, golden and ecosystem-units check were not run by me.
